topic: Write to a Friend About a Travel Experience(给朋友写一次旅行经历)
genre: 应用文 / 书信(travel experience email/letter)
source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit 2 Reading for Writing:write to a friend about a travel experience。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,暑假和家人去了一个地方旅行。请用英语给你的朋友 Sam 写一封电子邮件(约80词),分享这次旅行,内容包括:① 你去了哪里、怎么去的;② 在那里做了什么、看到了什么;③ 你的感受;④ 邀请对方下次一起去。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. You travelled somewhere with your family during the summer holiday. Write an email (about 80 words) to your friend Sam to share the trip, including: 1) where you went and how you got there; 2) what you did and saw; 3) how you felt; 4) an invitation to go together next time.
points: 去哪里 + 怎么去(I went to … We got there by …)
做了什么 + 看到什么(We visited … / We saw …)
感受(It was amazing / I'll never forget …)
邀请(I hope we can go together next time.)
model_essay:
Dear Sam,

How are you? I want to share an amazing trip with you. This summer my family and I travelled to Peru. We flew to Lima and then took a train into the mountains. We visited Machu Picchu, an ancient city of the Inca, and hiked up a narrow path to reach it. The view from the top was wonderful, and I will never forget it. I learned so much about the local culture and food. I really hope we can travel there together next time!

Yours,
Li Hua
model_translation: 亲爱的 Sam:你好吗?我想和你分享一次精彩的旅行。今年夏天我和家人去了秘鲁。我们飞到利马,再坐火车进山。我们参观了印加古城马丘比丘,沿着狭窄的小路爬上去。山顶的景色美极了,我永远忘不了。我学到了很多当地的文化和美食。真希望下次我们能一起去那里!李华

rubric.criteria: 四要素齐全:去哪+怎么去 / 做了看了什么 / 感受 / 邀请
书信格式完整(称呼+正文+落款),要点顺序清晰、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样,正确使用过去时叙述旅行,语法基本无误

required_structure: 去哪+怎么去 I/We travelled to … We got there by …
做了看了什么 We visited … / We saw …
感受 It was amazing / I'll never forget …
邀请 I hope we can … together next time
key_expressions: I want to share an amazing trip with you.
We travelled to … / We flew to … and then took a train.
The view was wonderful, and I'll never forget it.
I hope we can travel there together next time!

high_sentences: This summer my family and I travelled to Peru.
We flew to Lima and then took a train into the mountains.
The view from the top was wonderful, and I will never forget it.
I really hope we can travel there together next time!

error_pairs.wrong: Last summer I go to Peru.
error_pairs.correct: Last summer I went to Peru.
error_pairs.note: 叙述过去旅行用一般过去时 went。

error_pairs.wrong: We arrived to Lima in the morning.
error_pairs.correct: We arrived in Lima in the morning.
error_pairs.note: arrive in + 大地点(城市/国家),不用 arrive to。

error_pairs.wrong: The view was so amazing that I can't forget it.
error_pairs.correct: The view was so amazing that I couldn't forget it.
error_pairs.note: 主句过去时,从句时态保持一致 couldn't。

paragraph_template:
【旅行邮件结构】
第1步 称呼+开场:Dear Sam, … I want to share … trip.
第2步 去哪+怎么去:We travelled to … We got there by …
第3步 做了看了什么:We visited … and saw …
第4步 感受:It was … I'll never forget …
第5步 邀请+落款:I hope we can go together next time. Yours, Li Hua
